newsitem.title: UK: Hall makes 25.7 mln stg cash call.
newsitem.headline: Hall makes 25.7 mln stg cash call.

text.p: Hall Engineering (Holdings) Plc said on Tuesday that it plans a one for four rights issue at 250p per share to raise around 25.7 million stg.

Hall also announced a new joint venture with Stadco Pressings, its automobile components business, and Takao Kinzoku Kogyo Company Ltd, to manufacture body components for Honda Motor Co Ltd and other car manufacturers.
It said the joint venture, in which Hall will have a 65 percent interest, will require capital expenditure of approximately 17.5 million stg over the next two years.

Hall said that since its half-year results in September 1996, the overall performance of the group has continued in line with expectations, "with significantly higher profits in continuing businesses in the second half."
Hall said pre-tax profit for the year ended December 31, 1996 was not less than 12.8 million stg after an exceptional loss of 1.6 million stg on the sale of its UK metal stockholding division.
